_comment: Structures where the VENDORED RNApuzzler oracle (src/vienna_layout, plot_coords_puzzler_sibling_only) does not terminate under a checkSiblingIntersections=1/checkAncestorIntersections=0/optimize=0 configuration -- checkSiblings restarts checkAndFixIntersections forever whenever an intersecting sibling pair is detected but its bounding wedges never overlap in angle-space (target_angle >= 0), since no config change is ever attempted/counted so the maximumNumberOfConfigChangesAllowed budget never trips. This is a genuine property of the reference algorithm in this (never shipped standalone) option combination, NOT a porting bug -- verified by running the vendored oracle itself under a hard 1.5s multiprocessing timeout per structure over benchmarks/hard_set.json. The native rna_layout port (src/layout_core/resolve_siblings.cpp) has a documented, provably-safe fix for its OWN check_ancestor=false/optimize=false scope (see check_siblings doc comment) and never hangs; this exclusion list only gates which structures the PARITY harness (tests/test_native_parity.py) can compare native output against a vendored oracle CALL at all. Regenerate via find_vendor_hangs.py-style multiprocessing probe if hard_set.json changes.
